```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(harmony)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(dplyr)

library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(ggplot2)
library(enrichplot)
## REVISION: patchwork and tidyr are used below but were not loaded.
library(patchwork)
library(tidyr)

## REVISION: revision/config/paths.R provides OUT_ROOT and the write guards
##   (png()/saveRDS() create missing output directories); the revision/tools
##   helpers provide the donor-level analyses and figure functions used below.
source(file.path(Sys.getenv("SCORCH_REPO", "."), "revision/config/paths.R"))

for (f in c("astro_cluster_features", "astro_figure_inputs", "astro_composition_donor",
            "astro_subtype_de_donor", "astro_reviewer_figures"))
  source(file.path(file.path(SCORCH_REPO, "revision/tools"), paste0(f, ".R")))

```

#Read in overall seurat object
This object is the one with all celltypes and regions integrated in one object.
```{r}
scorch_combined <- readRDS(file.path(OUT_ROOT, "01-Regional_data_processing/combined/data/seurat_combined_v2.RDS"))
```

#Subset the Astrocytes
```{r}
Idents(scorch_combined) <- "consensus_annotation_v3"
scorch_astrocytes <- subset(scorch_combined, idents = "Astro")
```

#Process at a sample level
```{r}
## REVISION: seurat_combined_v2.RDS has the RNA assay split (183 layers), and
##   Seurat v5 errors with "Please join before splitting". Same fix as
##   combined/03. JoinLayers() is a no-op on a joined assay.
scorch_astrocytes <- JoinLayers(scorch_astrocytes)
scorch_astrocytes[["RNA"]] <- split(scorch_astrocytes[["RNA"]], f = scorch_astrocytes$sample_name)
scorch_astrocytes

scorch_astrocytes <- NormalizeData(scorch_astrocytes)
scorch_astrocytes <- FindVariableFeatures(scorch_astrocytes)
scorch_astrocytes <- ScaleData(scorch_astrocytes)
scorch_astrocytes <- RunPCA(scorch_astrocytes)
```

#Integrate all the samples
```{r}
scorch_astrocytes <- IntegrateLayers(
  object = scorch_astrocytes, method = HarmonyIntegration,
  orig.reduction = "pca", new.reduction = "harmony_astro",
  verbose = FALSE
)
```

#Visualize using tSNE
```{r}
scorch_astrocytes <- FindNeighbors(scorch_astrocytes, reduction = "harmony_astro", dims = 1:30)
scorch_astrocytes <- FindClusters(scorch_astrocytes, resolution = 1, cluster.name = "harmony_astro_clusters")
```

```{r}
scorch_astrocytes <-  RunTSNE(
  scorch_astrocytes,reduction = "harmony_astro", tsne.method = "FIt-SNE", check_duplicates = FALSE, do.fast = TRUE, seed.use=3, dims = 1:30, perplexity = 200,
  fast_tsne_path=FAST_TSNE_PATH, ann_not_vptree=FALSE, nthreads=14
)
```

# Figure inputs
REVISION: the chunks below use objects that the published notebook never creates
(de_edgeR, genes, scorch_meta, heatmap_list, deg_results).
`astro_figure_inputs()` loads them from the outputs under OUT_ROOT.
```{r}
inp <- astro_figure_inputs(source_de = "cross_region", counts = "uncorrected")

de_edgeR     <- inp$de_edgeR      # donor-level pseudobulk edgeR, all cell types
genes        <- inp$genes         # enrichGO universe = the genes actually tested
scorch_meta  <- inp$scorch_meta   # combined@meta.data, ALL cell types (for S12a)
heatmap_list <- inp$heatmap_list  # empty list the S15 loop fills
deg_results  <- inp$deg_results   # per-cell-type DE, Seurat column names but
                                  # DONOR-LEVEL statistics underneath (see
                                  # deg_results_from_de in astro_figure_inputs.R)

## source_de = "cross_region" because the astrocyte object spans INS/PFC/VST.
## Pass "INS" / "PFC" / "VST" instead for a region-specific panel, and say which
## in the legend either way - "astrocyte DE" means different things across them.
##
## deg_results keeps FindMarkers' column names so the S15 loops run unchanged,
## but the numbers come from the donor-level pseudobulk DE rather than a
## cell-level Wilcoxon. The logFC scale differs between the two, so the loops'
## avg_log2FC cutoffs are not equivalent to the published cell-level cutoffs.
```

```{r}
#PWH
## REVISION: sign corrected. The published filter `logFC < 0.25` selects
##   everything below +0.25, including every gene the PWoH panel selects (on the
##   revised data, 730 of 798 "PWH" genes were PWoH genes), so the two GO panels
##   were near-identical by construction. Genes up in PWH are logFC > 0.25
##   (1,613 genes, no overlap with the PWoH set).
top_edgeR_pwh_all <- de_edgeR  %>%
  dplyr::filter((avg_CTR_frq > 0.05) | (avg_HIV_frq > 0.05))%>%
  dplyr::select(gene,cluster_id,logFC,logCPM,p_adj.glb) %>%
  dplyr::filter((logFC > 0.25)&(p_adj.glb < 0.05))

top_edgeR_pwh_all$method <- "edgeR"

cell_types <- unique(top_edgeR_pwh_all$cluster_id)
top_edgeR_pwh_list <- lapply(cell_types,function(cp) top_edgeR_pwh_all[top_edgeR_pwh_all$cluster_id == cp,])
names(top_edgeR_pwh_list) <- cell_types

cp <- "Astro"
top_edgeR_pwh <- top_edgeR_pwh_list[[cp]]

ego_pwh <- enrichGO(gene          = top_edgeR_pwh$gene,
                keyType       = "SYMBOL",
                OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
                universe      = genes,
                ont           = "BP",
                pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
                qvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
                readable      = TRUE)
ego_pwh_df <- ego_pwh@result

# Compute -log10(p.adjust) and keep only the top 10
## REVISION: the published code piped the enrichResult object (ego_hiv) rather
##   than the data frame extracted on the line above, which fails with "no
##   applicable method for 'slice_head'". Now matches the PWoH branch.
ego_pwh_df <- ego_pwh_df %>%
  mutate(logP = -log10(p.adjust)) %>%
  arrange(desc(logP)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)  # Select top 10 terms

# Plot
p_fig1b_pwh <- ggplot(ego_pwh_df, aes(x = logP, y = reorder(Description, logP))) +

            hjust = 0, 
            color = "black",

            fontface = "italic") +

    x = "-log10(p.adjust)", 
    y = NULL, 
    title = "Top 10 Enriched GO Terms in PWH Astrocytes"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),  
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),  
    axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black"), 
    axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "gray90", linetype = "dashed"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),  
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), 
    plot.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 20, b = 20, l = 20)  
  )
p_fig1b_pwoh
save_fig(p_fig1b_pwoh, "Fig1B_GO_PWoH_astrocytes", width = 10, height = 7)
p_fig1b_pwh
save_fig(p_fig1b_pwh, "Fig1B_GO_PWH_astrocytes", width = 10, height = 7)
```

```{r}
dim_plot <- DimPlot(
  object = clean_scorch_astro,
  reduction = "tsne",                 
  group.by = "subcluster_labels",     
  label = TRUE,                     
  repel = TRUE) +
  theme_void() +

  labs(title = "t-SNE with Subcluster Labels")


#FeaturePlots for marker  genes
## REVISION: reduction set explicitly. Without it Seurat uses its default order
##   (umap, then tsne, then pca) and draws on `umap`, which this object inherits
##   from seurat_combined_v2: an embedding of all 641,923 cells of every type,
##   not of the astrocytes. The astrocyte-specific embedding is `tsne`, computed
##   in this notebook from harmony_astro (`harmony` is the combined one).
feature_plots <- FeaturePlot(
  object = clean_scorch_astro,
  features = c("GFAP", "CD44", "AQP4", "OSMR", "SERPINA3", "CHI3L1", "SYT1", "GRIA1"),
  reduction = "tsne",
  ## draw expressing cells on top of the zeros; with ~73k sparse nuclei the
  ## positive cells are otherwise buried under the grey ones
  order = TRUE,
  combine = FALSE
)

## Palette in one place: "grey_red", "viridis_hi", "heat", "blues" or "magma_hi".
## See FEATURE_PALETTES in revision/tools/astro_cluster_features.R; all keep
## the low end near-white because most nuclei are zero for any given gene, and a
## dark floor makes the zeros look like signal.
FEATURE_PAL <- "grey_red"

feature_plots <- lapply(feature_plots, function(p) {
  p +
    feature_scale(FEATURE_PAL) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 12)
    )
})

# attempting to organize the feature plots in a specific way
feature_plots_top <- feature_plots[1:4]  
feature_plots_bottom <- feature_plots[5:8]

# 2x2 grid
feature_grid_top <- wrap_plots(feature_plots_top, ncol = 2)

# 1x4 bottom row
feature_grid_bottom <- wrap_plots(feature_plots_bottom, ncol = 4)

## the assembled grids, and the combined panel
feature_grid <- feature_grid_top / feature_grid_bottom

save_fig(dim_plot,            "Fig1D_astro_subtype_tsne",   width = 10, height = 8)
save_fig(feature_grid_top,    "Fig1D_feature_grid_top",     width = 8,  height = 8)
save_fig(feature_grid_bottom, "Fig1D_feature_grid_bottom",  width = 14, height = 4)
save_fig(feature_grid,        "Fig1D_feature_grid",         width = 14, height = 12)
```

###E
```{r}
## REVISION: the published code used a cell-level Wilcoxon
##   hiv_reactive_markers <- FindMarkers(clean_scorch_astro, ident.1 = "HIV-Reactive", min.pct = 0.05)
##   which a reviewer noted has inflated type I error. astro_subtype_de()
##   pseudobulks each donor twice (their cells of the subtype, and their
##   remaining astrocytes) and tests within donor, so the replicates are donors
##   rather than nuclei. The subtype label "HIV-Reactive" is now "Reactive-PWH".
source(file.path(SCORCH_REPO, "revision/tools/astro_subtype_de_donor.R"))
sde <- astro_subtype_de(clean_scorch_astro, subtype = "Reactive-PWH")

geneList <- setNames(sde$de$logFC, sde$de$gene)

## REVISION: select the genes that mark the population (up only).
##   The published cell-level version used abs(logFC) > 1.5. Applied to the
##   pseudobulk DE that gives 478 genes, of which only 92 are up and 386 down, so
##   the enrichment would describe what Reactive-PWH lacks rather than what
##   defines it. The 1.5 cut was also tuned for Seurat's cell-level avg_log2FC;
##   pseudobulk logFC is a different quantity. At FDR < 0.05 the up-gene counts
##   are logFC > 0.5 -> 900, > 1.0 -> 307, > 1.5 -> 92.
FIG1E_LFC <- 0.5      # up genes at FDR < 0.05; 0.5 -> 900, 1.0 -> 307
gene <- sde$de$gene[sde$de$FDR < 0.05 & sde$de$logFC > FIG1E_LFC]
message("[Fig1E] up-regulated marker genes into enrichGO: ", length(gene),
        "  (FDR < 0.05, logFC > ", FIG1E_LFC, ")")

#use enrichGO
hiv_reactive_pathway_test <- enrichGO(gene = gene,
                    keyType       = "SYMBOL",
                    OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
                    ont           = "BP",
                    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                    pvalueCutoff  = 0.01,
                    qvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
                    readable      = TRUE)

## REVISION: family = "Arial" replaced by "sans". Arial is not a registered PDF
##   font in the container, so the PDF device raises "invalid font type"; "sans"
##   maps to Helvetica, which is metrically equivalent to Arial.
## Enrichment is computed on all 900 up genes above; only the display is
## thinned, so the p-values and the terms selected are unaffected.
## N_SHOW of 40-80 keeps the gene axis legible.
N_TERMS <- 10         ## hard cap on pathways shown
N_SHOW  <- 40         ## genes drawn; fewer = larger tiles

## Pick the display genes from the terms being shown, ranked by significance.
## Globally-top genes would leave many of them in no displayed pathway and the
## heatmap sparse.
show_genes <- genes_in_top_terms(hiv_reactive_pathway_test, n_terms = N_TERMS,
                                 de = sde$de, n_genes = N_SHOW)
message("[Fig1E] ", N_TERMS, " pathways, ", length(show_genes), " genes drawn")

hm <- heatplot(trim_enrich(hiv_reactive_pathway_test, show_genes, n_terms = N_TERMS),
               foldChange = geneList, showCategory = N_TERMS) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0) +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 1),  
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, color = "black", family = "sans"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", color = "black", family = "sans"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16, color = "black", angle = 45, hjust = 1, family = "sans"),
    text = element_text(color = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, family = "sans"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", family = "sans"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, family = "sans")  
  ) +
  RotatedAxis() +
  ggtitle(expression(bold("GO Enrichment Heatmap for Reactive-PWH Astrocytes")))

save_fig(hm, "Fig1E_GO_heatmap_Reactive_PWH", width = 16, height = 9)
```

#Supplementary Figures
##S12a
```{r}
#scorch meta is the scorch_combined@meta.data
comparisons <- list(c("PWoH", "PWH"))
astro_plot_data <- scorch_meta %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    region = dplyr::case_when(
      grepl("_INS$", sample_name) ~ "INS",
      grepl("_PFC$", sample_name) ~ "PFC",
      grepl("_VST$", sample_name) ~ "VST",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown" # Default if no match
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample_name, region, condition_new) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    total_cells = n(),
    astro_cells = sum(consensus_annotation_v3 == "Astro"),
    astro_percentage = (astro_cells / total_cells) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

astro_violin_plot <- ggplot(astro_plot_data, aes(x = condition_new, y = astro_percentage, fill = condition_new)) +
  geom_violin(trim = TRUE, alpha = 0.6, position = position_dodge(0.8)) +
  geom_jitter(size = 2, alpha = 0.8, position = position_dodge(0.8)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("CTR" = "#0072B2", "HIV" = "darkorange1")) +
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = comparisons,
    method = "t.test",
    label = "p.format"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~region, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Abundance of Astrocytes by Region and Condition",
    x = "Condition",
    y = "Astrocyte Cell Percentage (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14), 
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14), 
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12), 
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5), 
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray80", linetype = "dotted")
  )

save_fig(astro_violin_plot, "S12a_astro_percentage_by_region", width = 11, height = 6)
```

##S13b
I've included the code for one region below, it's the same for all the regions, you just need to load the signac objects and follow the same format for the other regions.
```{r}
#find the barcodes that overlap with RNA and ATAC
#load in the signac object for the regions --> signac_ins
#convert the ATAC formatting to RNA formatting for cell names
atac_barcodes <- sapply(colnames(signac_ins),function(cname){
  splited = strsplit(cname,'_')[[1]]
  return(paste0(splited[2],'-',splited[1]))
})

#find the overlap of cells and subset based on those cells
rna_barcodes <- colnames(clean_scorch_astro)
barcodes_clean <- gsub("-INS$", "", rna_barcodes)
sum(atac_barcodes %in% barcodes_clean)
overlap_barcodes <- atac_barcodes[atac_barcodes %in% barcodes_clean]

signac_ins_astro <- subset(signac_ins, cells = overlap_barcodes)

#add the metadata (subcluster labels to signac object)
clean_meta <- clean_scorch_astro@meta.data
clean_meta$barcodes <- gsub("-INS$", "", row.names(clean_meta))
meta_to_add <- data.frame(row.names = clean_meta$barcodes, labels = clean_meta$subcluster_labels)
signac_ins_astro <- AddMetaData(signac_ins_astro, meta_to_add)

ins_peaks <- FindMarkers(
  object = signac_ins_astro,
  ident.1 = "HIV-Reactive",
  test.use = "wilcox",
  min.pct = 0.1
)

ins_peaks <- ins_peaks %>% filter(avg_log2FC > 0, p_val_adj < 0.05)
ins_peaks$gene <- rownames(ins_peaks)

ego_vst_h <- enrichGO(gene          = ins_peaks$gene,
                      keyType       = "SYMBOL",
                      OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
                      ont           = "BP",
                      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                      pvalueCutoff  = 0.01,
                      qvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
                      readable      = TRUE)


hiv_pathway_plot <- dotplot(ego_vst_h, showCategory=12) + ggtitle("Top INS ATAC HIV-Reactive Pathways")
```

##S15
```{r}

source(file.path(SCORCH_REPO, "revision/tools/astro_figure_inputs.R"))
inp <- astro_figure_inputs(source_de = "cross_region", counts = "uncorrected")
deg_results <- inp$deg_results
length(deg_results)          # number of cell types
head(deg_results[[1]])       # avg_log2FC, p_val_adj, pct.1, pct.2

# downregulated genes for each celltype
for (cell in names(deg_results)) {
    degs <- deg_results[[cell]]
  degs$Gene <- rownames(degs)
  
  degs <- degs %>% 
    filter(p_val_adj < 0.05, avg_log2FC < -0.5, pct.1 > 0.05)
  
  geneList <- degs$avg_log2FC
  names(geneList) <- degs$Gene
  
  #make sure we have enough degs for pathway analysis
  if (length(geneList) > 10) {
    
    pathway_test <- tryCatch({
      enrichGO(
        gene          = names(geneList),
        keyType       = "SYMBOL",
        OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
        ont           = "BP",  
        pAdjustMethod = "BH",
        pvalueCutoff  = 0.01,
        qvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
        readable      = TRUE
      )
    }, error = function(e) NULL)  # error check
    
    #see if there are enrichment results
    if (!is.null(pathway_test) && nrow(as.data.frame(pathway_test@result)) > 0) {
      
      #get just the top 5 pathways
      pathway_df <- as.data.frame(pathway_test@result) %>%
        arrange(p.adjust) %>%  
        slice_head(n = 5) %>% 
        dplyr::select(Description, geneID) %>%
        separate_rows(geneID, sep = "/") %>%
        inner_join(degs, by = c("geneID" = "Gene")) %>%  
        group_by(Description) %>%
        top_n(10, wt = abs(avg_log2FC))  #keep only the top 10 genes per pathway
      
      # order the genes based on pathway
      pathway_df$geneID <- factor(pathway_df$geneID, levels = unique(pathway_df$geneID))
      
      pathway_df$Description <- factor(pathway_df$Description, levels = rev(unique(pathway_df$Description)))
      
      p <- ggplot(pathway_df, aes(x = geneID, y = Description, fill = avg_log2FC)) +
        geom_tile(color = "white") +
        scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0) +
        theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
        theme(
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 12, color = "black"),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
          panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
        ) +
        labs(title = paste("GO Enrichment (Downregulated) -", cell),
             x = "geneID",
             y = "Pathway",
             fill = "Log2FC")
      
     
      heatmap_list[[cell]] <- p
    } else {
      message(paste("No significant pathways found for", cell, "- Skipping heatmap."))
    }
  } else {
    message(paste("Not enough significant genes for", cell, "- Skipping enrichment analysis."))
  }
}

heatmap_list
save_fig_list(heatmap_list, "S15_pathway_down", width = 11, height = 7)

#save the output
```


#Upregulated DEGs
```{r}
## REVISION: reset the accumulator. Both S15 loops write into heatmap_list;
##   without the reset the second loop's set also carries the first loop's plots.
heatmap_list <- list()

for (cell in names(deg_results)) {
    degs <- deg_results[[cell]]
  degs$Gene <- rownames(degs)
  
  degs <- degs %>% 
    ## REVISION: sign corrected. The published `avg_log2FC < 0.5` selects
    ##   everything below +0.5, including every gene the downregulated loop
    ##   above selects (as in Figure 1B's PWH panel). Up genes are avg_log2FC > 0.5.
    filter(p_val_adj < 0.05, avg_log2FC > 0.5, pct.1 > 0.05)
  
  geneList <- degs$avg_log2FC
  names(geneList) <- degs$Gene
  
  #make sure we have enough degs for pathway analysis
  if (length(geneList) > 10) {
    
    pathway_test <- tryCatch({
      enrichGO(
        gene          = names(geneList),
        keyType       = "SYMBOL",
        OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
        ont           = "BP",  
        pAdjustMethod = "BH",
        pvalueCutoff  = 0.01,
        qvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
        readable      = TRUE
      )
    }, error = function(e) NULL)  # error check
    
    #see if there are enrichment results
    if (!is.null(pathway_test) && nrow(as.data.frame(pathway_test@result)) > 0) {
      
      #get just the top 5 pathways
      pathway_df <- as.data.frame(pathway_test@result) %>%
        arrange(p.adjust) %>%  
        slice_head(n = 5) %>% 
        dplyr::select(Description, geneID) %>%
        separate_rows(geneID, sep = "/") %>%
        inner_join(degs, by = c("geneID" = "Gene")) %>%  
        group_by(Description) %>%
        top_n(10, wt = abs(avg_log2FC))  #keep only the top 10 genes per pathway
      
      # order the genes based on pathway
      pathway_df$geneID <- factor(pathway_df$geneID, levels = unique(pathway_df$geneID))
      
      pathway_df$Description <- factor(pathway_df$Description, levels = rev(unique(pathway_df$Description)))
      
      p <- ggplot(pathway_df, aes(x = geneID, y = Description, fill = avg_log2FC)) +
        geom_tile(color = "white") +
        scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0) +
        theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
        theme(
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 12, color = "black"),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
          panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
        ) +
        labs(title = paste("GO Enrichment (Upregulated) -", cell),
             x = "geneID",
             y = "Pathway",
             fill = "Log2FC")
      
     
      heatmap_list[[cell]] <- p
    } else {
      message(paste("No significant pathways found for", cell, "- Skipping heatmap."))
    }
  } else {
    message(paste("Not enough significant genes for", cell, "- Skipping enrichment analysis."))
  }
}

save_fig_list(heatmap_list, "S15_pathway_up", width = 11, height = 7)
```
